notes: בְּ of שָׁמַע בְּקוֹל is unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV promoting its object to the direct object of *obey*; the parallel בְּ of תִדְבָּקוּן בּוֹ keeps the written *unto*, the relation the ASV does state.
The coordinated verbs share the auxiliary written for the first, and the ASV's rewritten *ye shall* before *serve* joins that verb under rule 17.
